features.description: PRIMARY: coded, directional parse diagnostics for duplicate/misplaced module declarations. Wire the dormant MOD002 (duplicate module) and add a new PAR_MODULE_PLACEMENT (misplaced/non-first module) at the parser declaration-dispatch site. Apply gemini's error-recovery fix: the recovery path (reportMisplacedModule) MUST NOT set seenModule/firstModulePos/firstModulePath — only ParseFile's valid leading-module consumption sets them, so a module-less file with two late modules emits PAR_MODULE_PLACEMENT twice (never a false MOD002 for the second). Kills the opaque PAR_NO_PREFIX_PARSE + PAR_UNEXPECTED_TOKEN cascade for a decl-level module token.

file_anchors.internal/parser/parser_file.go:48-51: Leading-module branch in ParseFile — the ONLY place that SETS seenModule/firstModulePos/firstModulePath; calls existing parseModuleDecl() helper at :49
file_anchors.internal/parser/parser_file.go:89: Existing standalone parseModuleDecl() helper (reused for consume-and-continue; no extraction needed)
file_anchors.internal/parser/parser_file.go:372-395: reportMisplacedImport / PAR_IMPORT_PLACEMENT precedent to mirror (NewSuggestionError + errCountBefore consume-and-truncate at :391-395)
file_anchors.internal/parser/parser_decl.go:209: parseTopLevelDecl switch — add `case lexer.MODULE: return p.reportMisplacedModule()`
file_anchors.internal/parser/parser_decl.go:328: case lexer.IMPORT precedent (was :336 in doc; shifted at HEAD)
